description: Benin - Elevation is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. Digital elevation data for Benin from CIATs SRTM 90m Digital Elevation Database v4.1. The original USGS/NASA SRTM data was provided in cells of approximately 90m x 90m, which has been processed to fill no-data cells and aggregated to 1km x 1km cells by CIAT [1]. Reference: [1] Jarvis, A., H.I. Reuter, A. Nelson, E. Coverage: Benin. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2008 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is restricted or on request according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is other closed licence (terms not stated in the catalogue entry). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
